mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT deliveries.id) FROM deliveries LEFT JOIN sales_orders ON sales_orders.delivery_id = deliveries.id AND sales_orders.status > 0 LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_cgroups ON customer_cgroups.customer_id = sales_orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN cgroups ON cgroups.id = customer_cgroups.cgroup_id
